invariants: topic, key, headers and strict JSON body identify the same tenant, baseline, version, consumer and event
candidate_sha256 and snapshot_sha256 exactly match the frozen version and activation target
one required consumer ACK never activates a version while another required consumer is pending or failed
the last required exact ACK atomically retires the prior active version, activates the frozen version, consumes approval and appends history/outbox
same consumer replay is accepted only with the same event_id and ack_sha256; changed bytes fail closed
source Kafka offset is committed only after the PostgreSQL activation transaction or durable poison-message DLQ acknowledgement
